name: Moonglade
summary: In Moonglade, a young tauren druid learns to reach nature’s ancient keepers. Guided by Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff, the initiate learns to cross the waking world and commune with them directly.

sections.title: A Sacred Haven Beyond Faction
sections.body: Moonglade lies beyond Kalimdor’s faction struggles. Keeper Remulos, son of Cenarius, watches over the ancient valley, a neutral refuge for all who follow nature. Night elf and tauren druids enter Nighthaven as equals, beneath the Cenarion Circle’s timeless mantle.

sections.title: The Leap Across Kalimdor
sections.body: Turak Runetotem teaches you a unique transport spell bound to Moonglade, aiding your spiritual and martial growth. Through your bond with the natural world, you cross hundreds of leagues in a heartbeat. The valley offers a place to study and a lasting refuge throughout your journey.

sections.title: Awakening the Bear
sections.body: In Nighthaven, you meet Dendrite Starblaze, an elder night elf druid who awaits new pupils. Under his guidance, you begin the first true trial of your calling: learning the bear’s perspective. To embrace the ways of the Claw, you must prove strength, courage, and balance before the Great Bear Spirit.

faq.q: Why can tauren visit a night elf haven like Moonglade?
faq.answer: Moonglade is sovereign sacred ground guided by the Cenarion Circle. Devotion to nature and Cenarius takes precedence over the Horde and Alliance conflict there, allowing tauren and night elf druids to train and dwell together in peace.
Dendrite Starblaze is an elder night elf druid in Nighthaven. He mentors newly arrived initiates of both races and administers their early trials as they attune to the ancient animal aspects.

Keeper Remulos is a mighty Keeper of the Grove and son of Cenarius. He is Moonglade’s supreme guardian, watching over the sacred barrows where sleeping druids hibernate and protecting the valley’s sanctity.

Speaking with Dendrite Starblaze begins your trial with the Great Bear Spirit. He sends you to the spirit’s home in northwestern Moonglade to learn strength of body and heart, the first step toward unlocking bear form.

faq.q: How does Teleport: Moonglade work lore-wise?
faq.answer: Druids weave natural ley energies and their spiritual bond with the Cenarion Circle to cross instantly from wherever they stand to Moonglade’s heart. Teleport: Moonglade is a spiritual anchor, letting them return for instruction and solace whenever summoned.
Turak Runetotem resides atop the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff. He mentors young tauren who heed the call of the wild before sending them onward to Moonglade.

angles.text: As a druid, this rite of passage bridges traditional tribal beliefs and the broader teachings of the Cenarion Circle. It opens the way to ancient shapeshifting forms.
As a tauren, arriving in Moonglade is a profound awakening. Your ancient ties to the Earth Mother align with the teachings of Cenarius.
As a Horde druid, you can cross paths peacefully with night elf druids in Moonglade, one of the few places in Kalimdor where this is possible.
